name: Wizerr
description:
Wizerr is decision infrastructure for hardware programs. 
This connector brings it directly into Claude.

Cross-reference parts, query datasheets, and check 
real-time supply chain data — without leaving your 
conversation.

What you can do:
- Cross-reference any part number to find DROP-IN and 
  ALTERNATE replacements, ranked by compatibility score
- Search components by natural language spec requirements 
  ("42V buck converter 2A automotive grade")
- Get real-time pricing, stock levels, and lead times 
  from major distributors
- Ask engineering questions about any component and get 
  answers sourced directly from the datasheet

Who it's for:
For OEMs, ODMs, suppliers, and distributors using Claude for engineering, supply chain, and FAE workflows.

Getting started:
1. Connect your Wizerr account via the OAuth flow
2. Ask Claude: "Find drop-in replacements for TPS24701DGK"
3. Get results instantly

A Wizerr account is required. Free accounts include a 
daily usage limit → app.wizerr.ai/pricing

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wizerr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wizerr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connector.wizerr.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wizerr MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wizerr provides these MCP tools: ask_part, autocomplete_part_number, cross_reference, get_supply_chain, and nlp_search_by_spec.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wizerr?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Wizerr in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Wizerr requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Wizerr is developed by Wizerr, Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
